name: Electric Power Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Electric Power Development Co., Ltd. operates as electric utility company in Japan. The company operates through Power generation business, Power transmission and transformation business, Electricity-related businesses, and Other business segments. It develops and operates hydroelectric power plants with total owned capacity of 8,560 MW; wind power with total owned capacity of 485 MW; geothermal power with total owned capacity of 100 MW; thermal power; solar; biomass; wind power; and nuclear business; as well as provides consulting services. Electric Power Development Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
